description_en: Queries the PrivateZone service configurations of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes接口查询云企业网实例的PrivateZone服务配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-private-zone-routes --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --access-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where you access the PrivateZone service.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
访问PrivateZone服务的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: access_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service is deployed
parameters.name: host_region_id

CenId.description_en: The ID of the CEN instance

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数

PrivateZoneDnsServers.description_en: The IP addresses of the DNS servers for the PrivateZone service

PrivateZoneInfo.description_en: The detailed configurations of the PrivateZone service

AccessRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where you access the PrivateZone service

HostRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service is deployed

HostVpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC that is associated with the PrivateZone service

Status.description_en:
The status of the PrivateZone service.

Creating: The service is being created.

Active: The service is active.

Deleting: The service is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
PrivateZone服务的状态。

Creating：创建中。
Active：可用。
Deleting：删除中
